purpose: Document first-party local registry context and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The exact WUP-point query returned an empty feature collection. A bounded 0.002° by 0.002° envelope request requested only OBJECTID, PRCL_KEY and geometry, returning three complete polygons in source-native EPSG:4148. One complete polygon (nearest) is retained; its single ring is closed and it is about 44.974 m from the unchanged WUP point. The server reported exceededTransferLimit, so the capped response and one retained neighbor do not prove point containment or represent all intersecting parcels.
